name: Park bench
about: A bench by a gravel path, with bushes, flowers and a lamp post.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a line one row in front of the bench and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Bench and bushes
layers.tip: Four oak stairs in a row, with their tall side at the back, make the bench. A block of leaves on each end is a bush. Start the lamp post with a fence, and plant flowers.

layers.name: Lamp post
layers.tip: One more fence on the post.

layers.name: Lantern
layers.tip: A lantern on top. Make one from iron nuggets around a torch.
